gen-gf-bonbon-gf-montserrat-alternates: Inviting and loose, Bonbon is heavy, casual lettering that feels jotted down by hand. Montserrat Alternates brings round letters whose rims match their stems, and that tidy geometry is what makes the casual hand above it work.
gen-gf-bowlby-one-gf-graduate: Graduate sets dignified, bookish letters with generous white between them. Bowlby One is best at filling the line with big closed bowls, while Graduate is best at spacing out open, level letters.
gen-gf-bowlby-one-sc-gf-graduate: Bowlby One SC stands tall and squarish like a woodblock letter, its mouths pinched shut where Graduate's stay open. Graduate's spaced-out, dignified lines make for a slow, steady read.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-archivo: Loose, hand-drawn, unhurried: Bpmf Iansui lays down one squeezed-out line with a flat, steady weight. Archivo takes over with outward-opening curves and a tall x-height, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-bespoke-serif: Bespoke Serif reads dignified and pleasant a paragraph at a time, its thin strokes about half the thick ones' weight. But Bpmf Iansui is best at relaxed, uninterrupted monoline strokes, where the serif is best at pen-pressure curves.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-epilogue: Bpmf Iansui draws every letter like a squeezed line of toothpaste, relaxed and hand-made. And Epilogue's tall, wire-like body with stubby ascenders is the pair's sharpest contrast against that loose hand.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-erode: Relaxed and inviting, Bpmf Iansui draws without hairlines or swells, one hand-made line all the way through. Erode handles the tempered stroke modulation and tall middle band, which the heading's flat, hand-drawn line never attempts.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-fira-sans: Relaxed and inviting, Bpmf Iansui looks hand-drawn, its open s and toothpaste-steady line set against Fira Sans's larger x-height. Fira Sans adds clean, uniform strokes beneath that loose hand.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-public-sans: Wire-bent and warm: Bpmf Iansui looks drawn by hand. Public Sans takes over with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, so paragraphs move along steadily and feel trustworthy.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-supreme: Supreme looks crisp and dense, a heavy strip of text with its letters held open. And Bpmf Iansui does the opposite job best, a relaxed hand-drawn line at moderate height, where Supreme owns the high lowercase.
